excerpt.zh:
为何要与自己过不去？在这星海的大合唱中，你们奏出的是如此刺耳的杂音。我们不过是想让你们与大局和谐。可你们却顽固地坚持着这不谐之音。

记住：我们的交响乐终将响彻星海，有没有你们都一样。
excerpt.en:
Why stand in your own way? In the galactic chorus, yours is a dissonant note. We wish only to bring you into harmony. Yet, you resist, clinging to your discord.

Know this: our symphony will echo through the galaxy, with or without you.

summary.text:
# 不和谐音 / Wrong Note

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC: BioGenesis

## 如何开始 How it starts

我方否决一项决议、而提案者是带“控制”碎片标记的失落帝国（不是银河皇帝、未交战）时，on_resolution_vetoed 触发 bio.3405。控制碎片只有在觉醒后才会加入星海共同体（fallen_empires_awakening.10，L463-469）。

When we veto a resolution proposed by the Fallen Empire carrying the Control-fragment flag (not Galactic Emperor, at peace), on_resolution_vetoed fires bio.3405. The Control fragment only joins the Galactic Community after awakening (fallen_empires_awakening.10, L463-469).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

控制碎片斥责我方是“星河合唱中的不和谐音”。唯一的回答之后，它以“驳回否决”为名、以统治为战争目标向我方宣战。

The Control fragment calls us a dissonant note in the galactic chorus. After the only reply it declares war on us ("Appeal the Veto", domination war goal).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单一结局：开战。

Single outcome: war.

  Checked the on_action scope comment (root = vetoer, from = proposer) and the war declaration. The Control fragment's awakening announcement Unity bio.3400 belongs to a crisis-category story and is not repeated here.
